# Camera

## Purpose
Fits the orthographic game camera to the board: renders only into the free screen area it is given and sizes itself so the board's bounds fill it, refitting when the window is resized.

## Concepts
camera, viewport, play area, fit, orthographic size, window resize, ICameraModel
